$comment: Manual fixes applied by tools/build-cards.js on top of docs/research/wiki-card-catalog.json. Keys are card ids (slug rule). Fields: mana, rarity, tribe, dirs, caps, base{attack,hp,ability}, growth{attack,hp,ability}[5] (null = unknown, derived from the rarity table), set, sets, sourceText, flags. Every entry needs a reason.

lightning-spirit.reason: Wiki infobox lists mana 1 and attack 'Monster' (placeholders). Other Legendaries cost 21-25; its 1400 hp / 700 ability put it in the middle of the tier, so 23 is used. The page says it never attacks the player, so it has no attack directions.

thief-of-time.reason: Wiki has no attack column. Battle screens in 2016–17 videos show ATK 0 (docs/research/round3/cardstats.md §1.3); its damage comes from the cumulative +ability per round (800 at L1, 5109 at ++++ L63). Kept at a flat 1 (like Scrapmaster) because the build requires an attacking card to have attack; the difference is 1 damage per hit.

scrapmaster.reason: Wiki lists attack 1 at level 1 and at every stage cap (1/1/1/1/1/1): the attack is a flat 1 and all its damage comes from the cumulative ability. Flagged flat so the 1.15 fusion reset does not round it up to 2 at +++.

isegrimm-stormgaze.reason: The catalog parser missed her hand-written table; values copied from docs/research/wiki/Isegrimm_Stormgaze.txt (lvl 1 / 12 / 18 / 24; +++ and ++++ unknown).

pyromancer.reason: Wiki '+' row (345/230/460) is below the unfused cap row and equals base × 1.15, i.e. the stage-1 level-1 values were typed in instead of the cap values. Marked unknown so the rarity table derives them. Album set Dwarven Apprentice (10/26; 2014 client: 1/17, nb_0000_hand.jpg): the set page of the 1.7.4-style client lists it (videos WzDCvHuf8FE / hJoyeys0cnI, silhouettes matched to the card art; docs/research/round5/starter-sets.md).

bone-dragon.reason: Wiki attack is 100 at level 1 and still 100 at the stage-0 cap (L15), then 650 / 300 / 400 / 500 at the + / ++ / +++ / ++++ caps: the attack does not grow with the level, only per fusion stage (its real damage comes from the revive that adds the ability value). The 650 at '+' breaks the +100-per-stage pattern and is treated as a typo for 200. Flagged flat so each stage uses its constant.

herb-collector.reason: Wiki '+++' life cell holds the junk value 'sorry' and the ability 2173 is below the curve; a talk-page comment gives L30 3299 / 2699, which fits the progression (2399 → 3299 → 4406, 1963 → 2699 → 3605).

siren.reason: The wiki says "Very Common", but 2016–17 battle screens show her with a green Uncommon frame at +2 L19, +3 L23 and +4 L27 (docs/research/round3/cardstats.md §3), i.e. Uncommon caps. The wiki checkpoints at 24/29 are the 23/27 caps mislabelled.

blood-spitter.reason: Self-damage is a flat 100 at every level and stage (wiki lists 100 at ++++ level 27 as well as at level 1); flagged flat so it does not grow. Album set Orc Grunt (12/26): the set page of the 1.7.4-style client lists it (videos WzDCvHuf8FE / hJoyeys0cnI, silhouettes matched to the card art; docs/research/round5/starter-sets.md).

goblin-mob.reason: The card's wiki infobox has no portal field, but the portal page lists it among the 8 set cards (docs/research/wiki/Desert_Twilight.txt, PortalCardTable).

tamer.reason: The wiki has only a partial row at L7 (855 / 428) and no cap value. Under the video-fitted growth curve (value = start + (cap − start)·t^1.1) that row implies stage-0 cap values of 1047 / 525 at L11.
